blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Inquirer’s two-part special report on the country’s growing debt burden won Best News Coverage at the 48th Catholic Mass Media Awards (CMMA). The reports, “Debt service eats up biggest slice of budget pie” and “PH debt stock projected to hit P19T by end of 2026,” were written by Krixia Subingsubing, Nyah de Leon and Dexter Cabalza, with Inquirer Research. The Catholic institution announced the winners of the 48th CMMA on Saturday. The special report explored the legal and historical origins of the Philippines’ debt and its impact on government spending and funding for public services. The first […]...
